note: Parser-robustness input for WP-B05, not a Canvas response. canvas-lms serializes Time values in the endpoints Tally calls as UTC 'Z' with zero fractional digits; offsets and fractions appear in GraphQL, in some other REST fields (e.g. user last_login via Time#iso8601), and in developer-doc examples. Every 'offset'/'fraction' value denotes the same instant as instant_utc truncated as shown.
